query: Fetch the Wikipedia page for Claude Shannon and tell me his birth and death dates and three key contributions to information theory.
final_answer: Born on April 30, 1916, and died on February 26, 2001. Key contributions: Foundational work in information theory, including the concept of entropy in information theory; development of the mathematical theory of communication, which laid the groundwork for modern digital communication; invention of the concept of the 'bit' as a unit of information and the development of binary data transmission.
